items.text: GitHub is rolling out public-preview connectors that let Copilot connect to verified MCP services once and reuse them across clients.
items.text_zh: GitHub推出公开预览连接器，让Copilot一次接入经验证的MCP服务并跨客户端复用。
items.cat_take_en: This lowers MCP setup friction, but centralized connector permissions become the new enterprise control point.
items.cat_take_zh: 它显著降低MCP接入门槛，但连接器权限管理将成为企业新的控制核心。

items.text: AWS added full fine-tuning to SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization for more than 25 open-source model families.
items.text_zh: AWS为SageMaker AI无服务器模型定制加入全量微调，支持超过25个开源模型家族。
items.cat_take_en: Serverless full fine-tuning widens access to deeper customization, though compute-heavy adaptation remains costly.
items.cat_take_zh: 无服务器全量微调扩大深度定制可及性，但高算力成本仍是主要约束。

items.text: Exa increased embedding throughput by 50% while indexing billions of documents on AWS AI chips.
items.text_zh: Exa在AWS AI芯片上为数十亿文档建立索引时，将嵌入吞吐提升了50%。
items.cat_take_en: The gain targets retrieval economics directly, benefiting large-scale search operators more than small application teams.
items.cat_take_zh: 这项提升直接改善检索经济性，大规模搜索运营商将比小型应用团队受益更多。

items.text: Epoch AI reported that Anthropic’s compute spending is growing fourfold annually, while customer inference represented about 26% of compute costs.
items.text_zh: Epoch AI称Anthropic算力支出年增四倍，而客户推理约占其算力成本的26%。
items.cat_take_en: R&D still dominates Anthropic’s compute bill, signaling that frontier-model competition remains investment-led rather than usage-funded.
items.cat_take_zh: 研发仍主导Anthropic算力账单，说明前沿模型竞争依旧由投资驱动而非使用收入驱动。

items.text: OpenAI said researchers’ AI use continues to rise exponentially, while agents are completing progressively longer research tasks.
items.text_zh: OpenAI表示，研究人员使用AI的速度仍呈指数增长，代理完成的研究任务也越来越长。
items.cat_take_en: Longer agent runs matter more than raw usage growth because they expose reliability and oversight limits in research workflows.
items.cat_take_zh: 代理运行时间比使用量增长更关键，因为它暴露了科研流程中的可靠性与监督瓶颈。

items.text: OpenAI introduced API completion windows that cut token prices by 30% for two-hour jobs and 40% for eight-hour jobs.
items.text_zh: OpenAI推出API完成窗口，允许两小时任务降价30%，八小时任务降价40%。
items.cat_take_en: This makes asynchronous agents economically viable, but developers must trade latency for savings and plan around delayed results.
items.cat_take_zh: 它让异步代理更具经济性，但开发者必须用响应延迟换取成本节省。

items.text: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, which generates blocks of tokens in parallel instead of producing one token at a time.
items.text_zh: 英伟达发布Nemotron-Labs-Sigma，可并行生成成块令牌，而非逐个生成令牌。
items.cat_take_en: Parallel decoding attacks inference latency at the architecture level, but quality and hardware-efficiency tradeoffs remain unproven.
items.cat_take_zh: 并行解码从架构层面冲击推理延迟，但质量与硬件效率取舍仍待验证。

items.text: Pika introduced Enact, a research preview for AI-video scenes designed to respond interactively to users.
items.text_zh: Pika发布Enact研究预览，让AI视频场景能够对用户进行交互式响应。
items.cat_take_en: Responsive scenes push video generation toward interaction, but persistent state and controllable behavior remain open challenges.
items.cat_take_zh: 响应式场景把视频生成推向交互，但持续状态与可控行为仍是未解难题。

items.text: Perplexity added Teammates and Multiagent features to its mobile app, including voice support for Teammates.
items.text_zh: Perplexity在移动应用加入Teammates与Multiagent，并为Teammates提供语音支持。
items.cat_take_en: Multiagent coordination broadens Computer’s reach, but mobile voice agents raise sharper privacy and confirmation risks.
items.cat_take_zh: 多代理协作扩大Computer的使用场景，但移动语音代理带来更突出的隐私与确认风险。

items.text: LlamaIndex released OCRia-1.5, improving complex-table, chart, form, and visual-grounding scores in LlamaParse.
items.text_zh: LlamaIndex发布OCRia-1.5，提升LlamaParse对复杂表格、图表、表单和视觉定位的处理表现。
items.cat_take_en: Better structure preservation directly improves document agents, especially where a single misplaced field can corrupt a financial answer.
items.cat_take_zh: 结构保留能力提升将直接改善文档代理，尤其能减少金融数据错位造成的严重错误。

items.text: Replit launched Missions, turning ambitious goals into plans that swarms of agents can execute for hours or days.
items.text_zh: Replit推出Missions，将复杂目标转成计划，由代理群持续执行数小时甚至数天。
items.cat_take_en: Long-running swarms could expand software automation, but unattended planning makes observability and rollback essential.
items.cat_take_zh: 长时间代理群可能扩大软件自动化，但无人值守规划让可观测性与回滚机制变得必不可少。

items.text: Mistral made Vibe available on desktop, allowing local or remote agents to run on macOS and Windows.
items.text_zh: Mistral将Vibe带到桌面端，支持代理在macOS和Windows上本地或远程运行。
items.cat_take_en: Desktop delivery gives Vibe a stronger coding foothold, while local execution increases the importance of permission boundaries.
items.cat_take_zh: 桌面化强化了Vibe的编程入口，但本地执行也提高了权限边界的重要性。

items.text: MongoDB open-sourced a Strands Harness SDK that stores agent sessions and long-term memories across machines.
items.text_zh: MongoDB开源Strands Harness SDK，可跨机器保存代理会话与长期记忆。
items.cat_take_en: Persistent memory removes a major agent usability gap, but cross-machine state now becomes a sensitive data-governance surface.
items.cat_take_zh: 持久记忆弥补了代理可用性缺口，但跨机器状态也变成敏感的数据治理面。

items.text: Runway said it reduced the GPUs needed to run a 57-billion-parameter video model at 24 frames per second from eight to four.
items.text_zh: Runway称，运行一个570亿参数视频模型并保持每秒24帧所需GPU已从八张降至四张。
items.cat_take_en: Halving inference hardware could materially improve video economics, though the claim still needs independent quality and throughput checks.
items.cat_take_zh: 推理硬件减半可能明显改善视频经济性，但画质与吞吐仍需独立验证。

items.text: Krea highlighted a Swissquote campaign made entirely with Krea-generated images and video, featuring four commercials and one recurring orange bull.
items.text_zh: Krea展示Swissquote全程使用其生成图像与视频制作的广告项目，共四支广告并围绕同一只橙色公牛展开。
items.cat_take_en: A coherent multi-commercial campaign shows generative tools moving beyond experiments, while brand consistency remains the decisive test.
items.cat_take_zh: 连贯的多支广告说明生成工具已走出实验阶段，而品牌一致性仍是关键考验。
